test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

This is the ___________ book that I have read till now.
solution:
The correct answer is **'most interesting'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The superlative form "most interesting" is used to compare more than two items, indicating that this book is the highest in terms of interest among all books read so far.
 
• In this context, the sentence is comparing this book to all other books read "till now," making the superlative form appropriate.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and 4 are incorrect as they do not convey the intended comparison.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"This is the **most interesting**__ book that I have read till now."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Option 2: "more interesting"** is incorrect because the comparative form "more interesting" is used when comparing two items, not multiple items.
 
• **Option 3: "interesting"** is incorrect because it lacks the comparative or superlative degree which is necessary in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "better interest"** is incorrect because this phrase is grammatically incorrect and does not fit in the context of describing a book.
